Overview

Yakima is a city in WA with a population of 94,000. Central Washington agricultural hub with wine country and the Yakima Valley sun. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.0.
